info.name: MajiPoa API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the MajiPoa water-delivery platform backend.

## Authentication
This API uses **Google OAuth2 / OIDC** with server-side sessions (cookies). There is no token endpoint to call directly.

### Sign-in flow
1. Open `GET /oauth2/authorization/google` in a **browser** — this redirects you to Google's sign-in page.
2. Sign in with Google. Spring Security processes the callback and sets a `JSESSIONID` session cookie.
3. The browser is redirected to `http://localhost:4200/auth/callback` — the Angular frontend.
4. The frontend (or Postman, if you copy the cookie) calls `GET /api/auth/me` to retrieve the user profile.

### Using with Postman
- Enable **"Automatically follow redirects"** and **"Send cookies"** in Postman settings.
- Open the browser-based sign-in via the OAuth2 initiation request in the `🔐 OAuth2 Flow` folder.
- Copy the resulting `JSESSIONID` cookie into the `session_cookie` collection variable, **or** use Postman's cookie manager to let it pass automatically.

## Variables
| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | `http://localhost:8080` | Backend base URL |
| `order_ref` | `WM10262` | Sample vendor order reference |
| `product_id` | `1` | Sample product ID |
| `sale_id` | `1` | Sample offline sale ID |
| `customer_id` | `` | Customer ID (auto-set on profile fetch) |
| `cart_product_id` | `` | Product ID used in cart operations (auto-set on product create) |
| `customer_order_id` | `` | Customer order ID (auto-set on order create) |

item.name: 🔐 OAuth2 Flow
item.description: Google OAuth2 sign-in flow endpoints. These are managed by Spring Security and must be opened in a browser to work correctly — they involve browser redirects to Google.

request.description:
Opens the Google OAuth2 sign-in flow.

⚠️ **Open this in a browser**, not Postman — it redirects to Google's sign-in page.

After a successful sign-in:
- Spring Security creates a server-side session
- Sets a `JSESSIONID` cookie in the browser
- Redirects to `http://localhost:4200/auth/callback`

Copy the `JSESSIONID` cookie value into the `session_cookie` collection variable to authenticate Postman requests.

query.description: Authorization code returned by Google (automatically populated during real flow)
CSRF state token (automatically populated during real flow)

request.description:
The OAuth2 callback URL that Google redirects to after successful sign-in.

⚠️ This is handled automatically by Spring Security during the real OAuth2 flow — you do not call this endpoint directly. It is listed here for documentation purposes only.

item.name: 👤 Auth
item.description: Session management and role-switching endpoints. All require an authenticated session (Google OAuth2 cookie).

request.description:
Returns the currently authenticated user's profile.

Called by the Angular frontend after the OAuth2 callback to restore session state and determine which role-based view to show.

**Response fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | Long | Internal DB user ID |
| `email` | String | Google account email |
| `name` | String | Display name from Google |
| `pictureUrl` | String | Google profile picture URL |
| `role` | String | `CUSTOMER` \| `VENDOR` \| `RIDER` \| `ADMIN` |

Ends the server-side session.

Invalidates the current `JSESSIONID` cookie. All subsequent requests will return `401 Unauthorized` until the user signs in again via Google OAuth2.

**Response:** `204 No Content`

Permanently upgrades the authenticated user's role.

Called when the user accepts the "Join as vendor" or "Become a rider" confirmation screen. This is a **one-way operation** — once set to VENDOR, the user cannot be demoted via API.

**Allowed role values:** `VENDOR`, `RIDER`

**Body:**
```json
{ "role": "VENDOR" }
```

**Response:** `UserResponse` with updated role.

item.name: 🛒 Customer
item.description:
All customer-facing endpoints covering profile management, product browsing, cart operations, and order placement.

## Authentication
Endpoints marked with 🔒 require `ROLE_CUSTOMER` (authenticated Google session with CUSTOMER role).
Endpoints marked with 🔑 require `ROLE_ADMIN`.
Unmarked endpoints are publicly accessible.

## Dynamic Variables
- `customer_id` — auto-populated from **Get My Profile**
- `cart_product_id` — auto-populated from **Create Product**
- `customer_order_id` — auto-populated from **Place Order**

item.name: 👤 Profile
item.description: Customer profile management. Covers fetching and updating the authenticated customer's own profile, as well as admin-level customer lookup.

request.description:
Returns the profile of the currently authenticated customer.

Requires `ROLE_CUSTOMER`. The customer is resolved from the session cookie — no ID needed in the URL.

The test script **automatically saves** the `customerId` to the `customer_id` collection variable for use in other requests.

**Response fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `customerId` | String | Internal customer UUID |
| `email` | String | Google account email |
| `firstName` | String | First name |
| `lastName` | String | Last name |
| `userName` | String | Display username |
| `pictureUrl` | String | Google profile picture |
| `role` | String | `CUSTOMER` |
| `phoneNumber` | String | Phone number |
| `address` | Object | Delivery address |

item.name: 🛒 Cart
item.description:
Shopping cart endpoints. All require `ROLE_CUSTOMER`.

The customer is always resolved from the session cookie — no customer ID in the URL.

**Typical flow:** Add items → View cart → Place order

request.description:
Adds a product to the authenticated customer's cart.

Requires `ROLE_CUSTOMER`. Uses `cart_product_id` variable (auto-set by Create Product).

**Body fields:**
| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `productId` | ✅ | String | ID of the product to add |
| `quantity` | ✅ | Integer | Number of units to add |

**Response:**
- `201 Created` — item added successfully (empty body)
- `400 Bad Request` — product out of stock, product not found, or customer not found

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Out of Stock
response.body: Product Out of Stock or User not found or Product not found

request.description:
Returns the authenticated customer's current cart.

Requires `ROLE_CUSTOMER`.

**Response fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | Array | List of cart items |
| `items[].cartItemId` | String | Cart item UUID |
| `items[].productId` | String | Product UUID |
| `items[].productName` | String | Product name |
| `items[].imageUrl` | String | Product image |
| `items[].quantity` | Integer | Quantity in cart |
| `items[].price` | BigDecimal | Unit price |
| `items[].subtotal` | BigDecimal | quantity × price |
| `totalQuantity` | Integer | Sum of all quantities |
| `totalAmount` | BigDecimal | Sum of all subtotals |

Removes a specific product from the authenticated customer's cart.

Requires `ROLE_CUSTOMER`. Uses `cart_product_id` variable.

**Path variable:** `productId` — the product to remove from the cart

**Response:**
- `204 No Content` — item removed
- `404 Not Found` — item not in cart

item.name: 📦 Orders
item.description:
Order placement. Requires `ROLE_CUSTOMER`.

An order is created directly from the customer's current cart — no body needed. The cart must have at least one item.

request.description:
Places an order from the authenticated customer's cart.

Requires `ROLE_CUSTOMER`. No request body — the order is built automatically from all items currently in the cart.

The test script **automatically saves** the `orderId` to the `customer_order_id` variable.

**Pre-condition:** Cart must have at least one item. Use **Add Item to Cart** first.

**Response fields:**
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | String | Order UUID |
| `totalAmount` | BigDecimal | Total order value in KES |
| `status` | String | Initial status: `PENDING` |
| `items` | Array | Snapshot of ordered items |
| `items[].id` | String | Order item UUID |
| `items[].productId` | String | Product UUID |
| `items[].quantity` | Integer | Quantity ordered |
| `items[].price` | BigDecimal | Unit price at time of order |
| `items[].subTotal` | BigDecimal | quantity × price |
| `createdAt` | String | ISO-8601 timestamp |

**Order status values:** `PENDING` → `CONFIRMED` → `SHIPPED` → `DELIVERED` (or `CANCELLED`)

**Response:**
- `201 Created` — order placed successfully
- `400 Bad Request` — cart is empty or customer not found
